channel.title: GitHub Go Languages Daily Trending
channel.description: Daily Trending of Go Languages in GitHub

item.title: alibaba / open-code-review
item.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

item.title: QuantumNous / new-api
item.description: A unified AI model hub for aggregation & distribution. It supports cross-converting various LLMs into OpenAI-compatible, Claude-compatible, or Gemini-compatible formats. A centralized gateway for personal and enterprise model management.

item.title: Autumn-27 / ScopeSentry
item.description: ScopeSentry-Cyberspace mapping, subdomain enumeration, port scanning, sensitive information discovery, vulnerability scanning, distributed nodes

item.title: majd / ipatool
item.description: Command-line tool that allows you to search for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, watchOS, visionOS, and macOS apps on the App Store, and download .ipa or macOS .pkg app packages.

item.title: Tencent / WeKnora
item.description: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.

item.title: larksuite / cli
item.description: The official Lark/飞书 CLI tool, maintained by the larksuite team — built for humans and AI Agents. Covers core business domains including Messenger, Docs, Base, Sheets, Calendar, Mail, Tasks, Meetings, and more, with 200+ commands and 20+ AI Agent Skills.

item.title: multica-ai / multica
item.description: Make humans and AI agents work as one team — open-source and self-hostable.

item.title: Wei-Shaw / sub2api
item.description: Sub2API 一站式开源中转服务，让 Claude、Openai 、Gemini、Grok订阅统一接入，支持拼车共享，更高效分摊成本，原生工具无缝使用。

item.title: TencentCloud / CubeSandbox
item.description: Instant, Concurrent, Secure & Lightweight Sandbox for AI Agents.

item.title: fish2018 / pansou
item.description: PanSou是一款高性能的网盘资源搜索API服务，支持TG频道和插件搜索。系统设计以性能和可扩展性为核心，支持多频道多插件并发搜索、结果智能排序和网盘类型分类。docker集成前后端，一键启动，开箱即用。仅供学习研究，请勿以各种形式用于盈利目的。 https://t.me/s/webhtv
